row.evidence: n8n's SAML docs say that if you remove a user from your IdP, they remain logged in to n8n and you need to manually remove them from n8n as well; no SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere in the n8n docs.
row.notes: Status changed partial -> none. June's 'SCIM provisioning gated to Enterprise' has no first-party source: the full n8n docs (llms-full.txt, all pages) contain no mention of SCIM, the SAML docs say users removed in the IdP must be removed manually in n8n, and the only automation is JIT account creation plus role/project mapping on SAML/OIDC sign-in and LDAP sync (LDAP: Cloud Enterprise, self-hosted Business+). Pricing is execution-based and flat per instance (unlimited users), so per-user fields are null. The US-rendered pricing page shows USD (Starter $20, Pro $50, Business $800 per month billed annually); the server-rendered HTML shows EUR (20€, 50€, 667€). June's 'Starter: EUR 24/mo' was a EUR figure and not re-checked on monthly billing. SAML SSO is on Business ($800/mo annual, self-hosted only) and Enterprise; OIDC is Enterprise only. Public REST API (users, roles, project membership) is on Cloud Starter, Pro and Enterprise and all self-hosted editions, but not the free trial.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: SAML and LDAP (self-hosted); OIDC is Enterprise only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Log streaming of audit events listed on Enterprise; no audit-log query API documented.

limitations.text: No SCIM: removing a user in the IdP leaves them logged in to n8n; admins must delete them manually in Settings > Users.

scim.notes: 'Available' is false by absence plus the manual-removal statement; n8n never says 'no SCIM' in words. Role and project access can be provisioned at SSO sign-in (SAML on Business+, OIDC on Enterprise) and re-evaluated each login.

auth.notes: Scoped API keys are Enterprise only; other keys have full access.

capabilities.notes: manage_groups = project membership (projects are n8n's grouping unit).

endpoints.purpose: Get user by ID or email
Change a user's role in a project
Remove a user from a project

limitations.text: Pagination: default page size 100, maximum 250, cursor-based.
The public API is not included in the n8n Cloud free trial.

okta.notes: OIN search returns no n8n app; n8n's own Okta guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app integration.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (saas-apps/n8n-tutorial 404); n8n documents an Azure AD SAML setup only.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP: account created on first LDAP sign-in, updated/removed at the next scheduled sync (Cloud Enterprise; self-hosted Business and Enterprise). SSO role and project mapping re-evaluated at every login.
